blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The total number of overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) repatriated from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia has reached 1,170, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) reported on Saturday. In its latest repatriation efforts, 70 OFWs arrived at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) – Terminal 3 on Friday aboard a Qatar Airways flight. “Ligtas na dumating sa Pilipinas ang 70 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) mula sa Saudi Arabia lulan ng Qatar Airways na lumapag noong November 13, 2026 sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3, Pasay City,” the DMW said in a statement.
